verdict.rationale: Requesty publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/openapi.json. It covers both the inference router and the management API, and the docs llms.txt advertises it. The probe's 404s were on different guessed paths, not the published one, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the published openapi.json path actually resolves and validates.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
